final: WITH t AS (SELECT a.player_id, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS tot FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id), av AS (SELECT AVG(tot) AS m FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.tot) AS sum_totals, AVG(t.tot - av.m) AS avg_excess FROM t, av WHERE t.tot > av.m
